$comment: Branding overlay rules for mold_v0 (mold_v0-024), read by .claude/scripts/branding.py. The codebase is never edited for an app: branding.py copies it to build/<app_id>/ and applies these rules to the copy, and every rule must match or the build is refused. NAME and WORDS go through the profile, never through source: the brand's fields are written into the copy's profile.json (the file scripts/gen-packs.mjs merges over the neutral default) and that generator is re-run, so src/profile.generated.ts and web/src/config/profile.generated.ts carry them (the MCP server name, the console's title and descriptions, the email sender's name). The tagline and description are written only when the brand has a tagline of its own; otherwise they are set to the shell's neutral words (`neutral`, gen-packs' DEFAULT_PROFILE), never left as the codebase's product's. `refuse`: characters the generator refuses in a name, so `set` and intake refuse them up front. The sender ADDRESS (email_from_address) is a mail-domain setting, not part of a brand, and is kept. LOGO: the favicon set (lib/favicon.py) goes to the console's web/src/app (favicon.ico, icon.png, apple-icon.png, icon.svg for a vector mark only) and web/public (the manifest's 192, 512 and maskable PNGs), and manifest_icons points the web manifest at them. COLOUR: only the brand-carrying tokens (primary, its foreground, ring) of the console's one theme, light and dark; its neutrals stay the mold's. This overlay does not rewrite source code: since mold_v0-039 a product's landing page and pages are its host pack's, and the console's own text takes the profile's name.
